verdict.summary:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent

The round-1 blocker is resolved. Repository identity is now normalized independently of credential identity, and the still-firing supersede path is gated on a genuinely distinct repository, so two credentials for the same tracker cannot close the sole active alert. The same helper also replaces the prior duplicated redaction comparison. The new decide-driven regression test exercises the supported same-repository/different-token configuration with case variation, proves the sole alert remains open without a supersede comment while firing, and verifies the ordinary recovery path still closes it. I found no new correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security issue in the diff.
